register_warmup_function: register a custom async warmup function using the @warmup decorator with a string name
run_warmup_functions: run a list of registered warmup functions against a tokenizer manager and disaggregation mode
warmup_voice_chat_kernels: warm up fused MoE triton kernels by sending synthetic generate requests for voice chat inference
access_warmup_registry: access the global _warmup_registry dictionary mapping warmup names to registered async functions
generate_synthetic_requests: generate synthetic requests with random input_ids and sampling params for kernel warmup
